description: Java class 'Receiver' implementing a command-line client for receiving messages via Hono's Telemetry and Event APIs, with methods for starting the client, creating consumers, handling messages, and managing connection status.

classes.name: Receiver
classes.description: A Spring component class that acts as a command-line client for receiving messages from Hono's Telemetry and Event APIs.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the receiver by connecting to Hono and creating message consumers.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Creates message consumers based on the message type (telemetry, event, or all).

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Processes received messages, logging device ID, content type, payload, and application properties.

methods.name: handleCreateConsumerStatus
methods.description: Handles the result of consumer creation, logging success or error and closing Vert.x if failed.
